decisions.name: Moulin Rouge Hotel & Casino
decisions.basis: April 2026 NGCB agenda contains a nonrestricted slot-machine-only licensing application at the historic address. A licensing/application record does not by itself establish an open public Dinner Roulette casino destination; keep outside runtime unless a current operating destination is independently established.

decisions.name: The ROW Reno group
decisions.basis: Same ownership/connected campus is not enough to collapse three separately branded casino properties; final active NGCB location-ID matching remains required.

policyFindings: Nevada nonrestricted status is broader than Dinner Roulette's destination-casino scope: NGCB defines a nonrestricted license as games/tables, 16+ slots, or games/tables with slots.
Therefore a current nonrestricted application/license record is strong regulatory identity evidence but not sufficient by itself to prove a venue is an open destination casino.
Closure/changeover procedures and current operation evidence must remain part of the final inclusion test.
